notes: Shared defaults. provider: jev (TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter, needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, never stored here) | laya (local) | kev (local, TypeSafe-compatible). --provider wins over env DECISION_PROVIDER, which wins over this file. flagMin: P(violation) at or above which a (rule, hunk) pair becomes a finding; 0.6 is a starting value, re-pick it from verdicts.mjs --summary. maxPairs caps questions per review. ignore: extra globs of files never checked. Per-machine overrides and per-project data consent live in jev.local.json (gitignored).
